quotes.text: "The Thundermail signin content should render inside the email form"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This landing moves the Thundermail button/divider and a localized setup h1 into the auto-config form body, removing the middle-content slot chain. The form marks its nested header with hide-title-on-thundermail; that header loads the stylesheet whose preference rule hides its old title and shows the body section. The browser task checks preference-specific visibility, form containment, empty slot name and the two title states. Its six affected assertion sites have explicit should messages. These DOM/style checks do not prove sign-in, native accessibility, focus or layout across sizes, and no test ran.
title: The Thundermail body title replaces the header title only under its preference
